newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bangkok Bank to underwrite 3-bln baht GHB bonds.
newsitem.headline: Bangkok Bank to underwrite 3-bln baht GHB bonds.

text.p: Bangkok Bank Plc will underwrite three billion baht worth of Government Housing Bank five-year bonds, a company statement said on Monday.
The bond, which was guaranteed by the Ministry of Finance, offered a fixed coupon rate of 10.22 percent per annum. The payment date is March 10.
The bank had planned to raise six billion baht in two tranches from bond issues in March.
This issue was one of two tranches.
In February, the Government Housing Bank also issued three-billion baht worth of bonds with a 9.45 percent coupon rate.
The proceeds would be used by the GHB to extend as loans for housing, bank officials said.
